skills.name: plugin-docs
skills.description: Read or search the built-in plugin development guide, API reference and manifest schema.

tools.name: plugin_docs
tools.description: Read or search the plugin development guide, API reference, or manifest schema.

skills.name: plugin-development
skills.description: Delegate plugin development and deployment to independent PluginAgents scoped to the current preset.
skills.instructions: Give each PluginAgent its own task and project. Spawn independent projects in parallel, send follow-up messages by ID, wait for their findings, and archive inactive agents. If you need to resume work on an existing plugin, use the original agent's ID. Only PluginAgent operates plugin files and deployments. Deploy or remove a plugin only when requested by the user.

tools.name: plugin_spawn
tools.description: Start an independent PluginAgent and return its persistent ID immediately.

tools.name: plugin_list
tools.description: List the current preset's PluginAgents with statuses and latest results.

tools.name: plugin_send
tools.description: Send a follow-up to an existing agent. Steers an active run at the next safe boundary.

tools.name: plugin_wait
tools.description: Wait briefly for one or several agents. Returns each status and any finished result.

tools.name: plugin_archive
tools.description: Stop and archive an agent while retaining its project and conversation.

tools.name: plugin_resume
tools.description: Restore an archived PluginAgent so you can send another task.

skills.name: plugin-project
skills.description: Read, edit, debug, publish and remove only the PluginAgent's own signed plugin project.
skills.instructions: Paths are relative to your source bundle. Preserve the assigned manifest id and packageName. Debugging runs a fixture event in an isolated V8 runtime. For OpenUI cards, read project_card_catalog and use project_card_preview on the draft before publishing. Inspect the diagnostics, rendered text, dimensions and controls. If your model accepts images, request screenshot: true to inspect the rendered PNG. Replay test interactions and verify the resulting state and action payloads. Edit the source and repeat until the card passes. Publishing validates the signed package and loads it for the current preset. Removing a deployment retains the local source.

tools.name: project_files
tools.description: List files in the assigned plugin project.

tools.name: project_read
tools.description: Read a text file in the plugin source directory with paging.

tools.name: project_write
tools.description: Write UTF-8 source, manifest, or text assets. Existing files require explicit overwrite.

tools.name: project_edit
tools.description: Replace a unique exact text match in a plugin source file.

tools.name: project_delete
tools.description: Delete a file from this plugin's source directory.

tools.name: project_debug
tools.description: Validate the signed draft and optionally invoke a declared Action hook with a fixture event.

tools.name: project_card_catalog
tools.description: Read the Android OpenUI component and syntax reference generated by the same library that renders plugin cards. Query a component name or page using next_offset.

tools.name: project_card_preview
tools.description: Render this draft's declared card in the Android OpenUI renderer. Optionally run an Action hook with a fixture event first to seed the isolated state. Use up to six steps, each naming a visible control and an optional value for an input. Linking or replying captures a payload. Each call starts with fresh state.

screenshot.description: Attach a PNG of the final rendered card to your next model request. Request this if your model accepts image input.

control.description: The exact label returned by the preview.

value.description: Set a value on a native input. Pass numbers as strings. Omit to click.

tools.name: project_publish
tools.description: Validate the draft and deploy its signed plugin. A new deployment is enabled only in this preset.

tools.name: project_remove
tools.description: Uninstall this project's deployment and retain its editable source.
